title: "R Notebook"
output: html_notebook
---


```{r}
# Create a 5 by 10 matrix of random integers
mx <- matrix(sample(1:1000, 50, replace = TRUE), nrow = 5, ncol = 10)

# Define column names
colnames(mx) <- c("cond1", "cond2", "cond3", "cond4", "cond5", 
                           "ctrl1", "ctrl2", "ctrl3", "ctrl4", "ctrl5")
# Define row names
rownames(mx) <- paste0("gene", 1:5)

# Compute the fold change for each gene. (mean of cond) / (mean of ctrl)
cond_means <- rowMeans(mx[, 1:5])
ctrl_means <- rowMeans(mx[, 6:10])

fold_change <- cond_means / ctrl_means

# Display results
results <- data.frame(
  Gene = rownames(mx),
  Fold_Change = fold_change
)

print(results)
```
